description: Item SA-000352 triggers an empty model response (provider-side content filter) in every GLM subagent request that includes it, across all judges and batch sizes. Isolated by bisection: ranges containing the item fail; adjacent ranges succeed.
handling: Excluded from expected items in run_judges; never judged in any stage; consensus computed over remaining 1060 items; flagged in LIMITATIONS and SILVER_FINDINGS; unblinding still joins its cohort metadata for transparency (no silver label).
